## Wili Files

Lists `.wili` projects from `1:/wilifiles/`. It appears after App Signals and
before Scripts on the main menu.

| Button | Action |
|---|---|
| Center / Ok | Load the selected project |
| Gray | Save the current project |
| Yellow | Reset panels, Wili Blocks and app signals |
| Green | Make the selected project the startup default |
| Blue | Remove the explicit startup default |
| Cancel | This help page |

Use the dedicated Home button to return to the main menu; Home is not repeated
on the soft-menu bar.

The explicit default marker is `1:/wilifiles/default.wili.txt`. If the current
project has no source path, Save writes `1:/wilifiles/default/default.wili`.
The same operations are under Scripting > Wili Files.

**See also:** [Wili Files](../features/wili-files.md) — the console/GUI commands for this panel.
